rca of the issue: Original actor-key bug (iter148 first run) was caused by duplicated token-key-name string list drifting from the canonical 'masci.<portal>.token' naming. E1 fixed by replacing the hard-coded list with the real names. Verified by direct repro: signed in as Safety, set tab=Open + search='foo', observed localStorage write at 'masci.ux.remembered.v1.tswvrb6.safety.ca.search' (hash matches Math.abs(JSHash(masci.safety.token)).toString(36) prefixed with 't'). Then logged out, signed in as HR, observed HR's hash differs and HR sees no Safety values via the resolver path. Recommended long-term mitigation: export KEY constants from each lib/<portal>Auth.js so the lookup list has a single source of truth.
